description: This file defines internal and public interfaces related to stream provider runtime management in Orleans, including methods for retrieving entity identities, stream directories, pub/sub systems, and managing stream subscriptions.

classes.name: IStreamProviderRuntime
classes.description: Interface for managing streaming providers, providing methods to get entity identity, stream directory, and pub/sub system.

classes.name: ISiloSideStreamProviderRuntime
classes.description: Extends IStreamProviderRuntime with initialization of pulling agents for persistent stream providers.

classes.name: StreamPubSubType
classes.description: Enumeration of publish/subscribe system types used by stream providers.

classes.name: IStreamPubSub
classes.description: Interface for pub/sub system managing producer and consumer registrations, subscriptions, and counts.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Returns the opaque identity of the currently executing grain or client object, mainly for logging.

methods.name: GetStreamDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the stream directory associated with the provider runtime.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub runtime interface based on the specified pub/sub type.

methods.name: InitializePullingAgents
methods.description: Starts the pulling agents for a specified persistent stream provider, given its name and adapter factory.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with a subscription ID to a specific stream, with optional filter data.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a specific stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a specific stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a unique subscription ID for a given stream and consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulty, possibly for recovery or cleanup.
